Application Materials.content:
All supporting documents including GMAT/ TOEFL/ IELTS scores must reach SMU by the stipulated deadlines. Please get ready contact details of two referrals for uploading and read the Applicant's Guide to Admission before submitting your application online.
How to Submit Your Application: complete the online application form and attach copies of the required documents as instructed. Your application will only be processed when SMU has received all the required documents and payment.
**Documents to submit**
1. Updated Resume
2. Undergraduate Degree Scroll
3. Undergraduate Degree Transcript
4. Any other supporting documents
5. SMU Admissions Test/GMAT/GRE
6. IELTS/TOEFL if undergraduate degree was not taught in English
7. Passport
8. Two References: please provide the name, email and contact number of two referees (they can be from your colleagues, superiors or friends). Referees will be notified to complete their referral forms online.
Applicants must also provide a personal statement explaining why they want to take the programme and how it fits with their career aspiration. Applicants are also required to provide contacts and details of two referees; an automated email upon submission of application will be sent to them to fill up the referral form.

Interview Requirements.content:
Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for an interview with the Admissions Panel. Interviews will be conducted between October to June for shortlisted applicants, and successful applicants will be informed within 1-2 weeks after the interview.
The application criteria state that shortlisted applicants will be invited for an online interview by members of the MPA Admissions Panel. The selection process is holistic and includes prior academic performance at university, work experience, referee reports, interview scores, etc.
FAQ: Only shortlisted applicants are invited for a personal interview. This will allow SMU to assess applicants holistically, taking into account achievements in all areas and selecting candidates who have the commitment, experience, motivation and potential to benefit from, and contribute to, the programme. For international students, telephone interviews will be conducted if they are not in Singapore.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Good Bachelor's Degree**.
- Applicants must demonstrate **good prior academic performance in an undergraduate degree from a recognised institution of higher learning**.
- Applicants must have **sufficient background in Mathematics/Calculus**.
- A good background in mathematics/calculus is essential; criteria used in evaluating this background include satisfactory completion of some mathematical courses at a university level, completion of at least two mathematical courses at polytechnic level with **minimum B grade**, or an acceptable foundation in mathematics at GCE A-level or O-level or its equivalent.
- Applicants with relevant working experience / post-undergraduate working experience will have an added advantage; work experience is not a compulsory requirement but will be considered favourably by the MPA Admission Panel.
- Applicants without a bachelor's degree will not be eligible for the programme; accreditation from the professional bodies specifically states that applicants must have a bachelor's degree.
- The SMU Master of Professional Accounting (MPA) was designed to provide a structured pathway into the accountancy profession for **graduates from non-accounting disciplines**, as well as professionals seeking to strengthen their accounting expertise.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- Applicants have the option to take [SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT)](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/sites/masters.smu.edu.sg/files/PDF%20docs/SMU%20candidate%20guide_refreshed.pdf) or GMAT or GRE as an admission test for application to the MPA programme. You are required to take an Admission Test for admission to the MPA programme, regardless of your academic background or prior qualifications.
- If you have previously taken the GMAT or GRE, it must have been taken within **five years** of the date of your application submission. GMAT/GRE scores are valid for **5 years** after the test date.
- Exempted from GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test: SMU Bachelor’s degree graduates with a minimum **cGPA of 3.0/4.0** within **5 years** of graduation; SUTD/NUS/NTU/SUSS/SIT Bachelor’s degree graduates with a minimum **cGPA of 3.5/5.0** within **5 years** of graduation. However, meeting the cGPA academic input does not guarantee acceptance and candidates may still be asked to take the GMAT/GRE/SMU Admission Test.
- To enhance the competitiveness of your application, you should attain a **GMAT score of 600 or higher**, OR a **GMAT Focus edition score of 595 or higher**. To make your application more competitive, you should achieve a minimum **GRE combined score of verbal and quantitative components of 312**.
- SMU's GMAT institution code for MPA is **F8D-3B-56**. Official score reports can be sent via the following Institution Codes: GMAT: **F8D-3B-56**; GRE: **2861** (Department Code: **4001 - Accounting**).
- Candidates without GMAT/GRE or with low scores have the option to sit for the [SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT)](https://masters.smu.edu.sg/sites/masters.smu.edu.sg/files/PDF%20docs/SMU%20candidate%20guide_refreshed.pdf). The SMUAT is an online test that can be done from home. If you dont sit for SMUAT, then SMU will need your GMAT/GRE score to assess your application.
- We will use your highest valid GMAT/GRE score.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- Applicants must show proficiency in the English language. A TOEFL (**Min. score: 90 or Band: 4.5**) or IELTS (**min. score of 6.5**) test is required if the applicant's undergraduate degree was not conducted in English.
- If your undergraduate studies were not taught in English, you must take the IELTS (International English Language Testing System) or TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language). An IELTS (**min. score of 6.5**) or TOEFL (**Min. score: 90 or Band: 4.5**) report is required.
- Either test must be taken within the last **two years** of your application submission. You will need to email the unofficial results of your test to the SMU Admissions Office and make a request at the relevant test centre to send your official score report to SMU.
- SMU's institution code for TOEFL is **9014**; official score reports can be sent using TOEFL institution code **9014** (Department Name: Accounting).
- Documents to submit include IELTS/TOEFL if undergraduate degree was not taught in English.

Program Overview.content:
The SMU Master of Professional Accounting (MPA) is offered full-time over 18 months, with flexibility to complete in 12 months, or part-time over 24 months. The programme is designed to provide a structured pathway into the accountancy profession for graduates from non-accounting disciplines, as well as professionals seeking to strengthen their accounting expertise. It prepares graduates for careers in professional services, finance, and corporate accounting roles across a wide range of industries.
The MPA programme consists of 14 course units (CU), including 8CU programme core, 4CU programme electives, 1CU general elective including internship, and 1CU postgraduate professional development course. Students may opt to undertake an internship in lieu of one general elective course to satisfy the graduation requirement; eligible students may complete the internship at any point during their course of study, provided that the minimum duration of 10 weeks is fulfilled. Full-time students continue from August to January after Term 3 for internship and/or exchange/overseas immersion programme. Part-time students are enrolled in evening classes.
The SMU MPA offers an accelerated route towards qualification for CPA or CA status and is recognised by **nine leading global and local professional accountancy bodies**. These recognitions offer eligible graduates multiple accelerated pathways towards professional qualifications and memberships across different accounting specialisations and jurisdictions.
The programme incorporates emerging skill sets in data technologies, sustainability reporting, and analytics, equipping students with up-to-date knowledge and practical capabilities. It also offers industrial internships and overseas study immersion programmes or exchanges as part of the MPA.
More than 88% of SMU MPA graduates are employed within six months of graduation, based on a survey conducted for students who graduated in 2024. Industries MPA graduates work in include Audit / Accounting (68.97%), Financial Services (10.34%), Education (6.90%), Healthcare (3.45%), Manufacturing (3.45%), Media (3.45%), and Real Estate (3.45%), based on the graduate employment survey in 2024.
Class profile from the Classes of 2022-2023 (Full-time & Part-time): age range 20s-50s; international students 94%; nationalities 9; average years of work experience 3 yrs; average GMAT 682.
Students gain access to industry professionals and leaders with real-world insights, in addition to being taught by a handpicked team of experienced and distinguished academics and educators from across the six different schools of SMU.

Curriculum.content:
- **Duration / format:** 18 months duration (Full-Time), with flexibility to complete in 12 months; 24 months duration (Part-Time). Part-time students will be enrolled in the evening classes.
- The MPA programme consists of **14 course units (CU)**, including **8CU programme core**, **4CU programme electives**, **1CU general elective including internship**, and **1CU postgraduate professional development course**.
- **Programme Calendar — Full-time:** Aug-Dec: 4 Core Modules; Jan-Apr: 3 Core Modules; May-Aug: 1 Core Module; Sep-Nov: 4 Programme Elective Courses + 1 General Elective Course or Internship; Professional Development Courses. Students may opt to undertake an internship in lieu of one general elective course to satisfy the graduation requirement. Eligible students may complete the internship at any point during their course of study, provided that the minimum duration of **10 weeks** is fulfilled.
- **Programme Calendar — Part-time:** Aug-Dec: 2 Core Modules; Jan-Apr: 1 Core Module; May-Aug: 1 Core Module; Aug-Dec: 2 Core Modules; Jan-Apr: 2 Core Modules; May-Aug: 4 Programme Elective Courses + 1 General Elective Course; Professional Development Courses.
| **Components** | **Courses** |
| --- | --- |
| **Programme Core (8 CU)** | Financial Accounting; Management Accounting; Corporate Reporting & Financial Analysis; Financial Management; Audit & Assurance; Accounting Information Systems; Management & Strategy; Data Modelling & Visualisation |
| **Programme Electives (Choose 4 CU)** | Advanced Financial Accounting; Corporate Advisory; Taxation; Legal Environment of Business; Programming for Business Analytics; Blockchain and the New Economies; Sustainability Accounting and Analysis |
| **General Elective (1 CU)** | Internship; Courses from the MPA programme Electives or other SMU Masters Programmes; Exchange/Overseas Immersion Programme; Advanced Taxation from UG curriculum |
| **Programme Activities** | SMU PG Professional Development Courses (1CU); Accounting Masters Ambassador Committee; Industry Talks/Masterclasses; Volunteer/Community Service Projects |
*The list of elective courses offered in a year is subject to changes. Advanced Financial Accounting, Corporate Advisory, Taxation, and Legal Environment of Business are recommended for students who are pursuing professional qualifications such as CA & CPA and plan to work in professional accounting firms.*

Cost of Attendance.content:
Living expenses will vary depending on your lifestyle and accommodation. However, the average international student would be able to stay within a monthly budget of **S$2000** - with change to spare. Estimated breakdown of basic living expenses:
| Item | Cost Per Month |
| --- | --- |
| **Accommodation** | **S$250 - S$800** |
| **Utilities** | **S$40 - S$100** |
| **Transportation** | **S$200** |
| **Telecommunications** | **S$50** |
| **Books & Stationery** | **S$200 per term** |
| **Personal Expenses (mobile phone, meals, etc)** | **S$100 - S$300** |
| **Food** | **S$300 - S$450** |

Financial Aid.content:
**奖学金**
- **Diana Koh 奖学金**：旨在支持和激励学生在学业上取得优异成绩，并对他们的成就给予适当认可。该奖学金价值**20,000新元**，将为获奖者提供年度学费和/或学习相关费用的经济支持。
- **资格条件**：申请人必须就读专业会计硕士（MPA）和财务大数据分析硕士（MSA）的学生；新加坡公民或新加坡永久居民；学术成就突出；积极参与课外活动及社区服务；在SOA或SMU社区中展示领导潜力和良好的公民意识；最低GPA为 **3.0（满分 4.0）**；根据大学的指标证明财务需求；捐助者面试环节。
- Diana Koh奖学金无需申请。依据上述要求，课程教师将通过考量之后颁发给MPA项目的学生。
- **SMU MASTERS东盟奖学金**：旨在激励来自东盟国家的优秀学生攻读SMU硕士学位课程，增加课堂的多样性和整体学习体验。奖学金获得者应成为SMU优秀大使，并积极参与学生发展/外展活动。每学年将颁发价值**10,000新元**的奖学金。
- **资格标准**：申请人必须是东盟成员国或观察员国（巴布新几内亚和东帝汶）的公民；申请人必须就读新加坡管理大学研究生课程（无延期）；优秀学术背景；非其他新加坡管理大学资助奖学金的同时获得者。
- SMU MASTERS东盟奖学金无需申请。依据上述要求，课程教师将通过考量之后颁发给MPA项目的学生。
- **SMU MPA全球卓越奖学金**：MPA项目提供的奖学金旨在鼓励所有国籍的优秀申请者攻读此项目，提升专业会计领域的知识技能。奖学金获得者应成为SMU优秀大使，并积极参与学生发展/外展活动。
- 符合资格的申请者每次入学将获得两项价值**5,000新元（包括消费税）**的奖学金。
- **资格标准**：申请人必须就读SMU MPA课程（无延期）；优秀的学术背景；非其他新加坡管理大学资助奖学金的同时获得者。
- SMU MPA全球卓越奖学金无需申请。依据上述要求，课程教师将通过考量之后颁发给MPA项目的学生。
\*奖学金名额可能会发生变化
**折扣机会**
- **SMU校友折扣**：将享受**5,000新元**的折扣。
- **SUTD校友**：总学费减免**10%**。
- **SMU推荐人折扣**：申请期间持有由 SMU 学生/校友填写的推荐人报告且符合录取标准的候选人，将自动获得**1,000新元**的折扣。
- **企业折扣**：若一家企业赞助（全部/部分金额）2名或以上的员工就读，可获得**3,000新元**的折扣。
新加坡管理大学保留在需要时修改新入学学生折扣计划的权利。

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for more than one programme, you are only required to take the test once. Please contact your first-choice’s programme office to register for the test and update the other programme office upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.
